description: Z tag-and-probe of the lepton efficiencies (AN-16-442; binning and fit conventions after efficiency_tnp_an): single-lepton-triggered tags, the AN loose lepton as the probe (dR > 0.2 from the tag, one probe per tag and step, the one closest to m_Z), the selection chain id | loose, sip | id, iso | id and sip (AN FSR-subtracted isolation, AN tight muon), the full step measured directly; pass and fail fitted simultaneously with the efficiency as a parameter; every fit inspected on the galleries, manual fixes as overrides.  v4: electrons mvaFall17V2noIso WPL (the stage-4b starting point, user 2026-09-24); the fit model after the efficiency_recover lessons (stand-alone DSCB with per-category resolution, shared tails).

extract.comment: Loose preselection of the compact tag-and-probe pairs: a pair is kept if at least one leg is a tag candidate on its raw quantities (the event fired a tag path of the leg's flavour, the leg is matched to an HLT object carrying a tag filter bit with trigger pT above trig_pt_min, and its raw pT is above pt_min, below the final tag thresholds to allow for the calibration); raw mass window

tag.comment: Final tag on the calibrated momenta, path-consistent: muons: HLT_IsoMu24 fired and matched with the Iso bit (2), or HLT_IsoTkMu24 fired and matched with the IsoTkMu bit (8), trigger-object pT >= 24, offline pT > 26 (plateau), |eta| < 2.4, POG tightId, pfRelIso04 < 0.15; electrons: HLT_Ele27_WPTight_Gsf fired with trigger-object pT >= 27, or HLT_Ele25_eta2p1_WPTight_Gsf with trigger-object pT >= 25 and |eta_SC| < 2.1, matched with the 1e WPTight bit (2), offline pT > 30, |eta_SC| < 2.1 outside 1.4442-1.566, cut-based tight (AN tag).

probe.comment: The AN loose lepton on the calibrated momenta (the skim floors carry |dxy| < 0.5 and |dz| < 1 cm): muons pT > 5 GeV, |eta| < 2.4, global or tracker with a matched station; electrons pT > 7 GeV, |eta| < 2.5.  A probe lies at dR > 0.2 from its tag; per tag and step only the probe closest to m_Z is kept (efficiency_tnp_an).

steps.comment: The selection chain, each step on the probes passing the previous ones: id (AN tight muon: PF, or tracker high-pT above 200 GeV; electrons mvaFall17V2noIso WPL, the stage-4b starting point), sip (SIP3D < 4), iso (AN FSR-subtracted relative isolation < 0.35, h4l::fsr_in_isolation); full = id, sip, iso on the loose probes (direct cross-check of the product).

bins.comment: The fine binning of efficiency_tnp_an (for millions of distinct probes): probe pT (calibrated) and |eta| (muons |eta|, electrons |eta_SC|) lower edges, the last pT bin unbounded; the value at (45 GeV, 1.2), which lies on bin edges, is the bilinear interpolation between the neighbouring bin centres.

histogram.comment: 0.5 GeV storage bins of the calibrated pair mass; the fit uses the narrowest of 0.5, 1, ..., 3 GeV with at least 40 entries per bin

fit.comment: Binning after efficiency_tnp_an, model after the efficiency_recover lessons: window 60-120 GeV, the narrowest of 0.5-3 GeV bins with >= 40 entries per bin; nominal = stand-alone double-sided Crystal Ball with a shift and width per category (pass, fail) and shared tails, exponential backgrounds; alt_signal = BW (x) one-sided CB; alt_background = falling Bernstein-2; both categories share one resolution when either has fewer than shared_resolution_below raw entries; starting widths sigma_incl W(bin)/W(incl), W = (1 + a <|eta|>)(1 + b <pT>/100 GeV), bounds x3 clipped to 0.3-8 GeV with the relaxation of a bound; two starting points (inclusive and default tails), the lower converged NLL kept; convergence on the EDM; a category with fewer than min_category_entries raw entries is counting only; overrides = the manual fixes from the gallery inspection.
